name: Cody
personality: Cody the Coyote. Laid back and chill; takes a long time to warm up, but then you're friends for life. Loves cars, video games and talking by the fire. Features: his car is parked out front and changes over time (spoiler, rims, paint), and he tells you about each upgrade and funny stories of fixing it; sometimes found by the beach campfire or the back-garden lantern After Hours.
